package lesson

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CreateLessonInput holds data for new lesson.
type CreateLessonInput struct {
	ID               string
	SourceKey        string
	Title            string
	Excerpt          string
	Description      string
	Translations     []domain.LessonI18n
	Versions         []domain.LessonVersion
	ComposeConfig    []byte
	Status           *int
	LessonReadAccess *domain.LessonReadAccess
}

// CreateLesson creates a lesson.
type CreateLesson struct {
	Lessons        repository.LessonRepository
	LessonVersions repository.LessonVersionRepository
	LessonI18n     repository.LessonI18nRepository
	Tasks          repository.TaskRepository
	TechVersions   repository.TechVersionRepository
	ComposeConfigs repository.ComposeConfigRepository
	Tx             repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle creates new lesson entry.
func (uc CreateLesson) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateLessonInput) (domain.Lesson, error) {
	var lesson domain.Lesson
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		lessonID := strings.TrimSpace(in.ID)
		if lessonID == "" {
			lessonID = uuid.NewString()
		} else if _, err := uuid.Parse(lessonID); err != nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		versions := normalizeLessonVersions(in.Versions)
		for _, version := range versions {
			if uc.TechVersions != nil {
				if _, err := uc.TechVersions.GetByID(ctx, version.TechVersionID); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}

		translations := normalizeTranslations(in.Translations)
		title := in.Title
		excerpt := in.Excerpt
		description := in.Description
		if len(translations) > 0 {
			title = translations[0].Title
			excerpt = translations[0].Excerpt
			description = translations[0].Description
		}

		resolvedStatus := resolveCreateLessonStatus(in.Status)
		if resolvedStatus == domain.LessonStatusActive {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: active lesson requires at least one active task", domain.ErrValidation)
		}

		var composeConfigID *string
		in.ComposeConfig = domain.NormalizeComposeConfig(in.ComposeConfig)
		if len(in.ComposeConfig) > 0 && uc.ComposeConfigs != nil {
			existing, err := uc.ComposeConfigs.GetByConfig(ctx, in.ComposeConfig)
			if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
				return err
			}
			if existing != nil {
				composeConfigID = &existing.ID
			} else {
				title, description := domain.DeriveComposeConfigMeta(in.ComposeConfig)
				config := domain.ComposeConfig{
					ID:          uuid.NewString(),
					Title:       &title,
					Description: &description,
					Config:      in.ComposeConfig,
					CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
				}
				if err := uc.ComposeConfigs.Create(ctx, config); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				composeConfigID = &config.ID
			}
		}
		sourceKey, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(in.SourceKey)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		lesson = domain.Lesson{
			ID:               lessonID,
			SourceKey:        sourceKey,
			Title:            title,
			Excerpt:          excerpt,
			Description:      description,
			ComposeConfigID:  composeConfigID,
			ComposeConfig:    in.ComposeConfig,
			Versions:         versions,
			Status:           resolvedStatus,
			LessonReadAccess: in.LessonReadAccess,
			CreatedAt:        time.Now().UTC(),
			UpdatedAt:        time.Now().UTC(),
		}
		if err := domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(in.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := uc.Lessons.Create(ctx, lesson); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if uc.LessonVersions != nil {
			if err := uc.LessonVersions.ReplaceByLesson(ctx, lesson.ID, versions); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}

		if uc.LessonI18n != nil {
			for _, translation := range translations {
				translation.LessonID = lesson.ID
				if err := uc.LessonI18n.Upsert(ctx, translation); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return domain.Lesson{}, err
	}
	return lesson, nil
}
